current_focus.summary: Repair the docs-only v1 handoff: Commerce owns cap ledger and merchant admin; Payments transports exact accepted totals and verified outcomes; Template owns shopper presentation; proposed ports carry durable attempt/coupon/rule/quote identities with idempotent atomic lifecycle; preserve failure-safe accepted-total invariant, Registry sandbox lock, and explicit unresolved semantics.
